concat_dataframes: concat multiple DataFrames or Series along rows or columns with optional axis and join parameters
merge_dataframes: merge two DataFrames or Series on a key column with inner, outer, left, or right join strategies
pivot_table_data: create a spreadsheet-style pivot table aggregating values by index and columns with configurable aggfunc
pivot_dataframe: reshape a DataFrame from long to wide format by specifying columns, index, and values
melt_dataframe: melt a DataFrame from wide to long format by unpivoting columns into key-value pairs
get_dummies_categorical: convert categorical columns into binary dummy indicator columns for machine learning preprocessing
cut_numeric_bins: bin continuous numeric data into discrete intervals with configurable bin edges and labels
qcut_numeric_quantiles: quantile-bin continuous numeric data into equal-frequency discrete intervals
